snippet.title: Rebuild 2 Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming soon: The eagerly awaited sequel to the top rated Flash Game Rebuild 
with over 5 million plays. Featuring new buildings, plotlines, characters,  customizable survivors with skills and equipment, new & improved art and  all new hidden endings to discover. The world will never be the same again.
